payload.title: role routing carrier signs
payload.body: Role routing needs the held role at projection time. At 46d24202 it is reachable only as canon's `role` dimension value, `anchorOf(agent.role)`. Forge's contract is that it never names a dimension (packages/schema/src/index.ts:504-507, `dimensionValueOf`), so reading `role` in forge would breach it. The plan instead carries the role on the `Agent` identity face, modelled on `skills`. That means an optional field on @cratylus/schema's `Agent`, set by canon's `holds` fold. Install reaches omp's routing table (default role, nearest built-in per role, config.yml path) through one optional `HarnessAdapter` member. Both are new public signs, one in the published schema and one in forge's exported port, and they are the architect's to name. Ruling owed: confirm the identity-face carrier over any manifest-level alternative, and name the Agent field and the HarnessAdapter member. Once ruled, revise unit role-routing's intent to spell both names, then clear this note's blocks.
